entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or press one to speak with an agent.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. Order number is VF-881-645-09.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF-881-645-09. I see it here. This is for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. Is that correct?
Yes. So can you process the return?
I can certainly look into that. Before I do, could I ask what specifically the issue is? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. It's not what I needed. I don't have time for a long call, just tell me if I can return it or not.

Understood. Our return policy can be quite firm on wearable electronics due to hygiene and sanitation reasons, and for some items it becomes too late after just a couple of weeks. Let me just confirm your eligibility...

Okay, looks like you're all set. Your purchase is well within the 90-day return window. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Do you see it in your inbox?
Let me check... yes, I just got it. Great. That's all I needed.

Perfect. Just pack the item in its original box, attach that label, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with?
You're welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, have a great day.
